### Remote Sensing
For my Introduction to Remote Sensing class, I independently researched how early-winter snow cover has changed in Minnesota across the past two decades. I used Python and RStudio to process 700 MODIS satellite images. Please see [this presentation](media/remote_sensing.pdf) for an overview of the process and results.
